title: SC04-T1 — nothing worked (SH01, SH02, SH03a, SH03b)
line: Every cream. Every serum. Every foundation on the shelf. / The Estée Lauder, the L'Oréal. And I look older in all of them.
motionPlan: her hand moves across the crowded vanity top, touching one bottle after another → Michelle, defeated, says it to the mirror, a jar in her hand → Michelle sweeps the bottles into the vanity drawer, shuts it, and sits back on the stool, small in the cool room → Michelle sweeps the bottles into the vanity drawer, shuts it, and sits back on the stool, small in the cool room
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
